candidate_ideas.statement: For a smooth proper genus-6 family over a locally Noetherian characteristic-zero scheme S with six pairwise disjoint ordered sections Gamma and balanced split CE bundle W=W_4 oplus W_5 of relative degrees 20 and 16, the CE evaluation-failure scheme Z_CE:=V(Fit_0(coker(pi_*W to pi_*(W|_Gamma)))) equals a_N^{-1}(e(S)) as closed subschemes, where N=omega tensor W_5^{-1}(Gamma) and a_N:S to Pic^0(C/S) classifies N; the equality is stable under arbitrary base change and needs no transversality or Tor-independence hypothesis.

The universal degree-16 evaluation maximal-minor ideal J=I_6(Phi) on Pic^0(C/S) equals the ideal sheaf I_e of the identity section as ideal sheaves (including over possibly nonreduced locally Noetherian bases).

On the universal ordered distinct configuration stack of a balanced CE family, Z_CE is the scheme-theoretic pullback of the reduced-support Abel–Jacobi incidence via the finite etale S_6-torsor Conf_6 to Div^6_rs, with compatible reduction of source and target over nonreduced bases.

For any g>=1 and n>=1, with Gamma a relative Cartier divisor finite etale of degree n and L_univ=omega(Gamma_P) tensor Poin^{-1}, one has Fit_0(coker(p_* L_univ to p_*(L_univ|_{Gamma_P})))=I_e on Pic^0; the (6,6)-specificity of the CE identification enters only through deg N=2g-2-deg W_5+n=0, not through this universal Pic^0 lemma.

The split hypothesis W=W_4 oplus W_5 may be replaced by the canonical Harder–Narasimhan filtration 0 to W_4 to W to W_5 to 0 (W_4 the degree-20 subbundle, W_5 the degree-16 quotient): since Gamma is finite, pi_* and restriction to Gamma stay exact, and coker(phi_4)=0 with the snake lemma yields coker(phi) isomorphic to coker(phi_5), hence Fit_0(coker phi)=Fit_0(coker phi_5) with no splitting used.

The geometric inclusion I_e subset J follows from the corank-1 normal form (5-by-5 identity block), first-order 6-by-6 minors recovering Hom(ker,coker) via Schur complement, J+I_e^2=I_e, and Nakayama for M=I/J.
The reverse inclusion J subset I_e holds because restriction along e gives coker(e^* Phi)=R^1 pi_* omega_{C/S}=O_S free of rank one, so Fit_0(coker(e^* Phi))=0 and hence e^* J=0.

established_facts.evidence: Packet primary locator SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 together with the packet CE line-bundle convention W_f:=(O(2) tensor gamma^*O(-f))|_C.
established_facts.statement: The Casnati–Ekedahl summands are W_f=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-f))|_C with deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f; for g=6 one has deg(W_4)=20 and deg(W_5)=16.
The CE obstruction decomposes as H^0(C, omega_C tensor W|_C^vee(Gamma))=oplus_i H^0(C, omega_C tensor W_{f_i}|_C^vee(Gamma)), and the obstruction line bundle for summand f has degree 4f+n-2g-14.
For (g,n)=(6,6) the f=4 obstruction has degree -4 and the f=5 obstruction has degree 0: deg(omega tensor W_4^{-1}(Gamma))=10-20+6=-4 and deg(N)=deg(omega tensor W_5^{-1}(Gamma))=10-16+6=0.

established_facts.evidence: Packet finding FND-0062; equivalently negative degree -4 of the Serre dual obstruction bundle.
established_facts.statement: On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover with balanced splitting F=O(4)oplus O(5), H^0(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma))=0 for every degree-six Gamma, so the f=4 CE evaluation obstruction vanishes identically.

established_facts.evidence: Packet finding FND-0063; fibrewise: a degree-zero line bundle on a smooth proper geometrically connected curve has a nonzero section iff it is trivial.
established_facts.statement: On the same balanced covers, evaluation fails on Gamma if and only if O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, equivalently N=omega tensor W_5^{-1}(Gamma) is trivial as a degree-zero line bundle.

established_facts.evidence: Riemann–Roch with R^1 pi_*W_f=0: h^0(W_4)=20-(g-1)=15, h^0(W_5)=16-(g-1)=11, and rank pi_*(W_f|_Gamma)=n=6.
established_facts.statement: If deg(W_4),deg(W_5)>2g-2=10 then H^1(W_4)=H^1(W_5)=0 fibrewise, so pi_*W_4 and pi_*W_5 are vector bundles of ranks 15 and 11 commuting with base change, while pi_*(W_f|_Gamma) has rank 6; the combined evaluation is a map of rank 26 to 12 whose Fit_0(coker) is the ideal of 12-by-12 minors.

established_facts.evidence: Column-selection rank bound: rank <= min(6,k)+min(6,12-k)<12 unless k=6; at k=6 the minor factors as a product of one 6x6 minor from each block. coker(phi_4)=0 because its Serre dual has degree -4, so Fit_0(coker phi_4) is the unit ideal.
established_facts.statement: For block-diagonal evaluation phi=phi_4 oplus phi_5, every nonzero 12-by-12 minor selects six columns from each block, so I_12(phi)=I_6(phi_4)I_6(phi_5) with no cross terms; combined with I_6(phi_4)=O_S one obtains I_12(phi)=I_6(phi_5).

The forgetful map from the relative ordered distinct configuration stack Conf_6(C/B) to the relative effective-divisor space of degree six is a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open locus, at stack level.

For ordered-to-unordered reduced-support constructions over possibly nonreduced bases, reduction must be applied compatibly: the canonical torsor is I to I^{red-supp}, and its reduced form is I_red to (I^{red-supp})_red; reducing only the source generally destroys flatness.

A fibrewise equivalence between nonvanishing of a CE obstruction space and triviality of a degree-zero line bundle establishes equality only on geometric points; identifying relative evaluation-failure with an Abel–Jacobi incidence over an arbitrary base requires comparison of determinantal/Fitting scheme structures.

established_facts.evidence: Relative degree 16>2g-2=10 forces vanishing of R^1; cohomology-and-base-change then applies to p_* and to evaluation.
established_facts.statement: For L_univ=omega_{C_P/P}(Gamma_P) tensor Poin^{-1} of relative degree 2g-2+n=16 on C x_S Pic^0(C/S), one has R^1 p_* L_univ=0, so p_* L_univ is a rank-(g+n-1)=11 vector bundle whose formation and evaluation map Phi commute with arbitrary base change.

established_facts.evidence: Top-degree base change plus Serre pairing H^1(O) x H^0(omega) to H^1(omega)=k is perfect; dim T_e Pic^0=g equals dim Hom(ker,coker).
established_facts.statement: At the identity section e of Pic^0, the evaluation Phi has ker=H^0(omega) of dimension g=6 and coker=H^1(omega) of dimension 1; the intrinsic derivative along xi in H^1(O) is cup-product H^0(omega) to H^1(omega), and Serre duality makes H^1(O) to Hom(H^0(omega),H^1(omega)) an isomorphism.

established_facts.evidence: Fitting ideals commute with arbitrary scalar extension; vanishing of R^1 licenses underived base change of p_* and of Phi.
established_facts.statement: Twisting an evaluation map by a line bundle pulled back from the base does not change its Fitting/maximal-minor ideal; with R^1 p_* L_univ=0 the W_5 evaluation matrix is the ordinary (underived) pullback of the universal Phi along a_N even when a_N is not flat.

Riemann–Roch chi(L)=1 for L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} of degree 6 on a smooth genus-6 curve proves only that the full Abel–Jacobi fibre in Sym^6 is nonempty; it does not prove that the reduced-support open or the ordered Conf_6 incidence is nonempty on every geometric fibre.

established_facts.evidence: Packet finding FND-0001 and the packet exact target W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6})=W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6})(21).
established_facts.statement: The exact open input is W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}), identified by Poincare duality with W_{2d-16} H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d) for d=3g-3+n; for (g,n)=(6,6) one has d=21 and ordinary degree 26.
